extensions.description: Provides agent driven UI using the A2UI JSON format.

card.description: Reads and acts on the user's GitHub: finds the pull requests that need them, opens one to its discussion and reviews, and posts, reviews, merges, and manages things for them — content-bearing actions drafted as a proposal and fired on their confirmation.
card.name: GitHub

scopes.github.read: See your repositories, pull requests, issues and notifications
scopes.github.write: Comment, review, merge, and open issues and pull requests as you

skills.description: Finds the pull requests that need the user: the ones waiting on their review, what changed recently, and what is still open.
examples: What pull requests need my review?
Which PRs are still waiting on me?
skills.name: Pull request triage

skills.description: Opens one pull request and shows the conversation around it: the description, the discussion, its reviews, and where it stands.
examples: Open the PR about the streaming fix
Where does the review stand on it?
skills.name: Reading a pull request

skills.description: Helps write review feedback on a pull request: drafts the review with the user, then submits it on their confirmation.
examples: Start a review on the streaming fix
Write up my feedback on this pull request
skills.name: Composing a review

skills.description: Performs GitHub actions as the user: comments on issues and pull requests, opens issues and pull requests, merges, edits files, and manages notifications. Content-bearing actions are drafted as a proposal showing where they will land and fire on the user's confirmation; quick toggles fire directly.
examples: Comment on that issue that I'll pick it up tomorrow
Open an issue about the flaky beat test
Reply to the review comment on #58
skills.name: Acting on GitHub
